regions.design: The main landscape is DISTANT STARS AT DISLOCATED DEPTHS AROUND SECLUDED HEAVENS. Vast deep and quiet space, sparse irregular stars, a few extremely remote pearly lights, barely visible layered cold dust giving contradictory senses of distance. No clocks, dimensional rings, cosmic faces or glyphs. The first dawn's faint warm stars enter from the left and rapidly thin; the right and lower reaches open into profound cold solitude continuing toward Silent Aeon. Two tiny private heavens almost lost within this immensity: Three Lives Heaven as a miniature quiet enclosed garden reach in the upper-right interior; Sanyue's Grotto-Heaven even smaller down to the left, with reflection courts barely perceptible. Unequal sizes, widely separated and not at legacy pin locations. Entire sites only3-5% image width, no hero globe, no close architecture. Overwhelming spaciousness, yet layered stellar depth and subtle differing distances rather than a plain flat black sheet. No third invented major site.
